t:
(a) 
The penultimate sentence of paragraph seventh of section 5136 of the Revised Statutes (12 U.S.C. 24) is amended—

        (1) 
by striking out “Federal Housing Administrator” and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary of Housing and Urban Development (hereafter in this sentence referred to as the ‘Secretary’)”;
 
        (2) 
by striking out “Housing and Home Finance Administrator” and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary”;
 
        (3) 
by striking out “Administrator” each place it appears and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary”; and
 
        (4) 
by striking out “Public Housing Administration” each place it appears and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary”.
  
    (b) 
Paragraph (11) of section 5200 of the Revised Statutes (12 U.S.C. 84) is amended—

        (1) 
by striking out “Housing and Home Finance Administrator or the Public Housing Administration” and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary of Housing and Urban Development”; and
 
        (2) 
by striking out “Administrator or Administration” each place it appears and inserting in lieu thereof “Secretary”.

fable.w: This section makes only technical conforming amendments, replacing references to former housing officials and agencies with the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development. The tempting reading is that naming federal housing officials implies some decision process, but no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government is created. Every actor mentioned is a federal official.

qwen_block.w: This section consists entirely of technical amendments to statutory text, specifically replacing outdated titles of federal officials (e.g., 'Federal Housing Administrator') with the current title ('Secretary of Housing and Urban Development'). It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or participation with parties outside the federal government. The changes are internal administrative updates within the federal government structure.

opus.w: This section is a technical amendment that replaces old agency titles with the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development. It sets up no process involving outside parties, such as consultation, hearings, comment periods, advisory bodies or a right to sue. The word "Public" in "Public Housing Administration" is just part of an agency's name, and that agency is inside the federal government.
